name: Valle de Villaverde (Spain)
description: Divided per saltire, green above and below, white at the hoist and red at the fly in the upper part, red at the hoist and white at the fly in the lower part, so that the colours are counterchanged.
history: Municipal flag of Valle de Villaverde; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: per saltire: green above and below, the hoist and fly triangles white and red counterchanged
